name: fractional_max_pool2d_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::fractional_max_pool2d_backward(Tensor grad_output, Tensor self, int[2] kernel_size, int[2] output_size, Tensor indices) -> Tensor. Scatters each output gradient back to the input position recorded by the matching fractional-max-pool indices. Coverage derives deterministic pooling regions from shared random samples, validates the forward indices exactly, and compares the backward result with autograd across square and non-square shapes. Inputs are not mutated and the result does not alias them.
